checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals winback-flow, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals winback-flow; description carries reactivation trigger phrases.

checks.description: The flow segments lapsed contacts by recency, frequency, and value (RFM-style), not all the same.
checks.rule: Body states lapsed contacts are segmented by recency, frequency, and value and consumes recency segments from segmentation-logic.

checks.description: Inactivity triggers follow the 30, 60, and 90 day recency pattern since last open, click, or purchase.
checks.rule: Body names inactivity triggers at 30, 60, and 90 days since the last open, click, or purchase.

checks.description: The reactivation sequence is 3 to 5 messages, ordered, cadence confirmed in the brief.
checks.rule: Output flow is an ordered 3 to 5 message reactivation sequence with cadence confirmed in the brief.

checks.description: The flow is ordered and each message has id, trigger, segment, channel, and a copy variant ref.
checks.rule: Output flow lists ordered messages, each with id, trigger, segment, channel, copy_ref, and subject_ref.

checks.description: Each message references a QA-passed copy variant by id; the flow never writes copy.
checks.rule: Body states each message binds to a QA-passed copy-package variant id and that the flow sequences copy and does not write it.

checks.description: Offer, price, promotion, discount, incentive, and inactivity threshold trace to the brief or live data; nothing invented.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing an offer, price, promotion, discount, incentive, inactivity threshold, Skill Path title, or instructor name; recency segment sizes resolve from live data at send.

checks.description: Suppression excludes paying contacts, unsubscribes, and hard bounces, and silent contacts enter the sunset-then-suppress step.
checks.rule: Output suppression names paying contacts, unsubscribed, and hard-bounced, excludes them, and routes still-silent contacts to a sunset-then-suppress step.

checks.description: Audience size and recency segment sizes are resolved from live data at send time, with a send_on_approval sentence.
checks.rule: Body and output state audience_size and recency segment sizes resolve at send, and a one-sentence send_on_approval describes what the send does and to how many.

checks.description: The platform open item is surfaced; the package is not-sendable until confirmed and approved.
checks.rule: Body marks the platform open item and marks the package design-only and not-sendable until the platform is confirmed and approved.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals, empowering not deficit-framed, RTL-safe Arabic.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals; any Arabic example is empowering and RTL-safe.
